rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=3, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=7, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.01, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-6 proj_n_bf=1/img_n_bf=7/lr1e-2/lneg1.0 hr=0.2555). (1) PRIOR: lambda_neg lowering HURT (iter-9 lneg0.1=0.2487) -> the negativity penalty is LOAD-BEARING for BFs (a bilateral cannot clamp negatives itself, unlike the DD-UNet); reverted to 1.0. img side fully mapped (depth7, kernel7, lr1e-2 all optimal). The PROJECTION-domain BF is still at its minimal proj_n_bf=1. (2) Failure mode: a single sinogram BF barely denoises the sparse-view sinogram before FBP; streaks that a deeper proj stack could suppress pre-reconstruction survive into the image. (3) ONE KNOB: proj_n_bf 1 -> 3 (best config otherwise). (4) HYPOTHESIS: 3 chained projection BFs denoise the sinogram more before FBP -> fewer streaks -> hr above 0.2555 toward ~0.26-0.27; if flat/down, proj-domain denoising is not the lever (image-domain dominates) and iter-11 pushes proj_kernel or reverts. (5) BUDGET: proj BFs act on the sinogram (smaller than 512x512 image); 3x cheap -> ~130s. (6) Loop continues. Artifacts saved.
